gateDefinitions.G1: provenance: provider, product, version, query/URL, retrieval time, license recorded
gateDefinitions.G2: file integrity: SHA-256 and byte size recorded; file readable
gateDefinitions.G3: coordinate validity: monotonic regular lat/lon, documented convention, within [-90,90]/[-180,360]
gateDefinitions.G4: time-axis validity: strictly increasing, calendar/units decoded, cadence recorded; irregular cadence allowed only if documented (weekly AVISO)
gateDefinitions.G5: variable availability: required variables present with standard/long names
gateDefinitions.G6: spatial coverage: every window ocean box inside the grid extent
gateDefinitions.G7: temporal coverage: frames bracket t0 and t0+72h for every window (no extrapolation)
gateDefinitions.G8: missingness: fraction of missing values in each window box at the bracketing frames recorded; release points must not be missing
gateDefinitions.G9: unit validity: velocity in m s-1 (or documented equivalent), SSH in m
gateDefinitions.G10: release-window coverage: for every drifter release point the nearest 4-node stencil is non-missing at both bracketing frames
gateDefinitions.G11: reproducibility: quality analysis re-run to a separate directory is byte-identical
